purpose: Minimize owner interruption while ensuring time-sensitive subscription, billing, account, and renewal risks are surfaced early enough for a human decision.

channels.activationGate: G6 owner approval required before recurring ChatGPT tasks are created or enabled

chatgptDelivery.urgentCheckCadence: hourly maximum supported frequency after G6 approval
chatgptDelivery.urgentNotificationRule: Notify only when an immediateAlerts rule is newly true or materially worsens; otherwise produce no notification.
chatgptDelivery.dailyNotificationRule: Send one compact brief only when one or more dailyBriefRules or unresolved owner decisions exist; otherwise produce no notification.
activationRequires: G6 manual end-to-end connector acceptance passed
explicit owner approval to enable recurring ChatGPT notifications
source of truth query path verified

immediateAlerts.when: authoritative evidence indicates payment failed, card declined, service suspension for nonpayment, or payment method action required
immediateAlerts.ownerAction: Review payment status and decide whether to repair billing. No automatic payment change.

immediateAlerts.when: evidence indicates suspicious login, credential compromise, account takeover warning, unexpected account-change notice, or security lockout
immediateAlerts.ownerAction: Review the account directly. The team does not change credentials or contact the vendor.

immediateAlerts.when: verified cancellation deadline is within 3 calendar days or has passed within the last 30 days
immediateAlerts.ownerAction: Make or review the keep/change/cancel decision. No cancellation is automatic.

immediateAlerts.when: verified renewal is within 3 calendar days AND record is low/unused, price-changed, unverified, disputed, or otherwise marked human-review-needed
immediateAlerts.ownerAction: Review value and billing evidence before renewal.

immediateAlerts.when: a new or materially unexpected single charge is at least 10000 cents and is not reconciled to an approved known subscription
immediateAlerts.ownerAction: Verify the charge and account context. No dispute or refund action is automatic.

dailyBriefRules.when: verified renewal is within 7 calendar days and no immediate-alert rule applies
renewal is within 30 calendar days AND usage is Low or Unused, confidence is Low/Medium, or Human Review Needed is true
authoritative evidence shows a subscription price changed
new recurring service or subscription candidate is discovered and not yet verified
billing cycle, renewal date, account email, plan, or status is materially unknown
usage state is Low or Unused
new evidence changes lifecycle to Paused, Cancelled, expired, or parked
two authoritative or near-authoritative records disagree on payment status, renewal, plan, or lifecycle state

silentRules.when: known subscription renews successfully at expected price and cadence with no exception
evidence duplicates an already-recorded event without changing facts
daily scan finds no new exception, material change, deadline, or unresolved owner decision

dailyBriefFormat.footer: No vendor, subscription, payment, credential, or spending action was taken.

briefSuppression.carryForwardCadence: once per daily brief until resolved or materially changed
